q1-direction.title: Alignment direction: align consumer to producer (nll+rank_mae), or emit brier/log_loss?
q1-direction.imperative: Which way to reconcile? Recommended: align CONSUMER to what the producer emits (corr_sigma_pi_trace_vs_rank_mae + corr_sigma_pi_trace_vs_nll), per PRE-RULING R2 default and design-doc §6.2 primary recommendation. Evidence search for brier/log_loss intent: producer uncertainty_calibration() only ever computes nll + rank_mae correlations; no code/comment anywhere intends brier or log_loss σ-trace correlations; gold eval surface standardized on pairwise_nll. Decision needed only if evidence of brier/log_loss intent is found.
q1-direction.finding: RESOLVED (code+history evidence, R2 default applies, NO exception): align CONSUMER to producer = corr_sigma_pi_trace_vs_rank_mae + corr_sigma_pi_trace_vs_nll. Evidence: git grep shows corr_sigma_pi_trace_vs_{log_loss,brier} exist ONLY in consumer file, never in any src producer; git log -S on producer side shows log_loss/brier sigma-trace correlations were NEVER emitted; consumer constant introduced in #225 was wrong from inception. No design-doc/comment intent for brier/log_loss. Producer canonical channels: pairwise_nll + rank_mae_vs_retro_bt.

q2-fieldstd-scope.title: Are corr_field_std_* correlations in scope for the σ wrong-sign gate?
q2-fieldstd-scope.imperative: The producer emits 4 correlations: 2 sigma_pi_trace_* (the σ channels) and 2 field_std_* (field-spread channels). _SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS is specifically the SIGMA wrong-sign/insignificant gate. Recommended: keep _SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS = the two sigma_pi_trace_* keys only (nll + rank_mae); field_std correlations are a different signal (field spread, not modelled uncertainty) and the gate name + issue scope are about σ. Do NOT widen the gate to field_std.
q2-fieldstd-scope.finding: RESOLVED: _SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS stays the two SIGMA channels only (sigma_pi_trace_vs_nll + sigma_pi_trace_vs_rank_mae). field_std_* are a distinct signal (field spread, not modelled uncertainty); gate name + issue scope are about sigma. Do NOT widen to field_std. Producer emits all 4 but consumer sigma gate consumes only the 2 sigma ones.

q3-test-structure.title: What structural form must the producer≡consumer pin take?
q3-test-structure.imperative: Admiral standing order: the pin test is the heart of the fix; make it STRUCTURAL — import both key sets and assert equality, not a copy-paste list. Recommended: test imports the consumer constant _SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS AND derives the producer's emitted σ keys from gold_module_cycle.uncertainty_calibration() output (run it on a fixture, take correlations.keys() filtered to the sigma_pi_trace_* ones), then assert set-equality. This pins both sides to live code so they cannot drift. A hardcoded expected-list test would NOT satisfy 'structural'.
q3-test-structure.finding: RESOLVED (Admiral standing order): structural pin = import consumer _SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS AND derive producer keys live from gold_module_cycle.uncertainty_calibration() output filtered to sigma_pi_trace_* correlation keys; assert set equality. Both sides bound to live code, cannot drift. Hardcoded list rejected.
